initial_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production texture atlas sheet for an original voxel sandbox adventure game. Create a precisely aligned 4-column by 3-row grid of 12 square texture tiles, filling the entire rectangular image edge to edge. No gutters, borders, frames, labels or text. Each tile must be a FLAT orthographic material swatch, not a cube render or object scene. Every tile uses the same clearly visible coarse pixel-art grid, approximately 32 by 32 large square colour pixels per tile, nearest-neighbour crisp edges, a restrained 6-to-10-colour palette, softly grouped pixel clusters, no smooth gradients, no photoreal micro-detail, no glossy highlights, no directional baked cast shadows. Intended to wrap 1-metre voxel cubes; quiet repeating patterns, not decorative framed panels. Natural warm earth colours with muted green vegetation; white snow should have light blue-grey recessed clusters, without dazzling pure white. Exact tile order, reading left to right: row 1 = dark russet spruce trunk bark with vertical broken ridges; spruce log end with subtle square-ish growth rings; muted deep blue-green spruce needles with compact irregular pixel clusters and a few small fully transparent square gaps; chalky ivory birch bark with short charcoal horizontal dashes. Row 2 = pale birch log end with soft square growth rings; lighter sage green birch leaves with irregular pixel clusters and a few small fully transparent square gaps; compact off-white snow surface with sparse pale cool shadows; rounded small grey and warm taupe gravel grains, clustered rather than high contrast noise. Row 3 = muted terracotta clay strata with irregular broad mineral mottles, no perfectly straight ruler stripes; forest floor of warm brown fallen leaf fragments and humus, low contrast; mossy grey stone with irregular muted green patches; wet riverbank silt in dark desaturated warm brown with sparse fine pebble pixels. All non-leaf tiles fully opaque and square, leaves have actual alpha for the few gaps only, never draw a checkerboard background. No logos, no borrowed game assets, no objects beyond the material patterns. Cohesive classic block-game pixel art, readable at small on-screen sizes.

forest_floor.prompt: Production pixel-art texture refinement for an original voxel sandbox adventure game. Using the attached sheet ONLY as a reference for coarse pixel scale and restrained natural colours, output ONE square, flat, orthographic, edge-to-edge FOREST HUMUS FLOOR texture tile. Do not output the multi-tile atlas. Replace the orange fallen-leaf pattern with quiet desaturated olive-brown earth and decomposed humus. A very limited 6-colour palette centred on muted brown-grey (approximately #645a45, #71664f, #5b5443, #797058); sparse small irregular dull olive leaf fragments, no bright orange, no yellow-gold. Group pixels into softly changing broad mottles, maintain narrow luminance contrast, avoid black crevices. Explicit coarse 32 by 32 pixel grid of large crisp square pixels over the whole image, nearest-neighbour edges, no texture inside pixels, no smooth gradients. Seamless tiling design, no central object or border. The purpose is a calm, low-contrast floor across large forest areas, so it should visually recede underneath tree trunks and grass. No bark, no parallel fibres, no twigs, no recognizable piles of leaves, no diagonal streaks, no large clover-shaped repeating motifs. Fully opaque, no shadows, no lights, no photoreal surface details, no labels, no grid lines. One square material swatch only.

clay.prompt: Create ONE standalone square production texture tile for a voxel sandbox adventure game. Use the attached sheet as a style reference for coarse square pixel art only. Material: dry canyon clay, subdued dusty terracotta blended with grey-brown mineral earth. Flat orthographic edge-to-edge opaque surface, no object, no grid, no border, no lighting, no text, no multi-tile sheet. Explicit crisp large square pixels, approximately 32 by 32 texels across the entire swatch, 6 to 8 closely spaced colours. Centre palette near muted dusty clay #956f59, #a27861, #886b58, #a6846d, with low contrast broad irregular cloudy mottles. Absolutely no stripes, no strata lines, no wood grain, no diagonal bands, no waves or swirls, no cracks, no sharp dark flecks, no bright orange-red. It must tile across a large cliff or flat plateau without looking like rows of wood planks. Calm matte earthen pattern with varied pixel clusters, visually subordinate to the block geometry. Seamless on all four edges; crisp nearest-neighbour pixel edges with zero fine detail inside the pixels. One clay material swatch only.
